label: Boutique Spas & Hospitality
heroHeading: A spa circuit that doesn’t add therapist hours
seoDescription: Premium wellness amenities for boutique hotels & luxury spas. HBOT, red light, infrared sauna & cold therapy with proven guest satisfaction ROI.

valueProps.title: A sauna guests photograph
valueProps.body: Charred cedar, light hemlock or a custom traditional room built to match your spa. The sauna is the room people talk about.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Made for all-day operation in a commercial spa, with cleaning that fits your housekeeping round.

valueProps.title: Bookable without staff time
valueProps.body: Cold and red light need no hands-on time during a session, so they sit on the spa menu without adding therapist hours. Staff still check and clean them through the day.

features.title: Contrast without a plunge pool
features.body: A dry cold room pairs with the sauna for a contrast circuit and needs no plant room, no pool chemistry and no drainage.

features.title: Built for your room, not a catalogue
features.body: For traditional saunas we design, manufacture, procure and install: benches, panelling, heater and lighting laid out for the space you have.
